notes.title: Devlog 0.1 Sensory Patch Games and With Me: Aquatic Time!
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45590378/6889cef8f7276cdd1980dce7158ea96102b3a632.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45590378/2989b71936eabefd3f1a04eb7309f0e48ca396fe.png[/img][/url]Hi everyone! We're Sensory Patch Games — an indie game studio founded by two close friends! 
(knock knock knock!)

Back in college, we were in an underground band together—writing songs, rehearsing, and performing at music festivals. After graduation, life took us in different directions, but somehow we both ended up in the game industry.
After going through all sorts of chaotic (and sometimes ridiculous) experiences at work (we’ll tell you those stories another time!), we each left our jobs.

By the end of 2024, we decided to team up and make an indie game together!
Why the name “Sensory Patch”?
Because we want to create an experience—a “patch” for the senses—that blends visuals, music, and interactivity to lead players into a space of emotional healing and inner balance. Through the power of art, we hope to touch something deep inside, and create a virtual world where players can relax, connect emotionally, and simply feel. Every game is a little journey for the soul—a quiet space to reconnect, restore, and just be.
(Ahem, that’s our official pitch.)

To be honest? We just want to make something cool, fun, and deeply comforting—and share it with all of you!!
Anxiety, stress, confusion? Yeah, we’ve got those too. That’s exactly why we wanted to make a space where we—and you—can find calm again, and focus on what truly matters.
We’re both heavy users of productivity tools, and—fun fact—one of us is obsessed with fish!

And that’s how our first project, With Me: Aquatic Time, was born.[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45590378/7b21a9df2672c7c30473cfad48eef56ea3447b80.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45590378/707a6c9fa019567bb6e5653a9f40e7df61f871da.png[/img][/url]

This game combines aquarium simulation with focus and time management tools.
Through a variety of beautiful fish, peaceful underwater scenery, and goal-setting mechanics, we hope to offer something more than just gameplay—something that feels like companionship and healing.
In many cultures, water symbolizes the flow of time, and fish are the spirits that move with it.
Your personal fish pond is like a corner of your soul—your private mental space where you can focus on what really matters. (cue lute music – bard voice)

So stay tuned for a game that will accompany you, record your peaceful moments, and bring serenity to your everyday life. Let’s enjoy the sparkle of water and the gentle rhythm of healing—together. (cue soft guitar strum)

We are Sensory Patch Games, and we’ll see you next time, friends~[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45590378/fcc5d35d2e77aca330b1aa33cb9ea94b6583c0a5.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45590378/1c1893f00c02718ad31c720159fa91992a747e22.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: With Me: Aquatic Time! Playtest will be available on April 26 at 09:00 UTC
notes.content:
First of all, a heartfelt thank you for joining our Playtest! 🥰 (If you haven't yet, don't miss it!)
The Playtest will run from April 26, 9:00 UTC to May 16, 16:00 UTC.

[i] With Me: Aquatic Time is a gamified focus tool that combines fish collection, aquarium decoration, and goal management. It’s designed to create a comfortable and relaxing environment that helps you enter a state of flow during study or work.
Simply put, you can nurture your fish, enjoy their growth and companionship, or set focus goals to make the game your productivity partner—the experience is entirely up to you! [/i]

As one of the early players of With Me: Aquatic Time, you might encounter some unexpected little issues. If you do, please don’t hesitate to submit a [url=https://fb6l41ouww.feishu.cn/share/base/form/shrcnuVhhBj4Et1u7cx1s2v9sde]Bug Report[/url] through the in-game settings, or leave your feedback in our Steam Community!
Your support will help us continuously improve the game experience!

If you fall in love with the game (which would truly be an honor! 💙) and would like to get more involved, we warmly invite you to share your thoughts through our [url=https://fb6l41ouww.feishu.cn/share/base/form/shrcnJfN2rNTloQgzb4rp4r8Pbf]Player Survey[/url] available in the settings menu.
Every single suggestion brings us one step closer to making the game even better!

[b]⚠️ A few important notes:[/b] 
[list]
[*] ⚡️ The game is still under development. Everything you experience during this Playtest is part of a test build and does not represent the final quality. We will continue refining and enriching the content. 
[*] 🐡 If you encounter any issues, please make sure to submit feedback through the in-game settings. 
[*] 🐟 Unfortunately, ‼️ save data from this version will NOT be compatible with future versions ‼️ due to technical limitations. However, your focus journey won’t be forgotten! If you submit the in-game survey and include your nickname, after verification, we will proudly include your name in the Playtesters' Thank You List! ❤️ 
[/list]

Meanwhile, we’ll post updates and behind-the-scenes content on our social media. Feel free to follow us on your favorite platform (or all of them? 😆)!

And last but not least: if you enjoy With Me: Aquatic Time, please don’t forget to add it to your wishlist or recommend it to your friends and family. Let's look forward to the official release together!

Wishing you a wonderful day,
— Sensory Patch Games 🎮🐠
